content:
Day One: Arrive in Tokyo. Enter the Meiji Shrine. Wander Harajuku streets. Taste fresh sushi at Tsukiji Market. Rest at a ryokan near Asakusa.  
Day Two: Explore the historic Asakusa district. See Senso‑ji Temple. Walk Nakamise shopping lane. Try ningyo‑yaki sweets. Ride the Sumida River cruise. View Tokyo Skytree at dusk.  
Day Three: Take the Shinkansen to Kyoto. Arrive at Kyoto Station. Visit Fushimi Inari Taisha. Hike the thousand torii gates. Drink matcha at a tea house. Stay in a machiya inn.  
Day Four: Wander the Gion quarter. Spot geisha hurrying to appointments. Tour Kinkaku‑ji the Golden Pavilion. Reflect at Ryoan‑ji rock garden. Sample kaiseki cuisine for dinner.  
Day Five: Journey to Nara by train. Feed the friendly deer in Nara Park. See Todai‑ji Temple housing the Great Buddha. Return to Kyoto for evening rest.  
Day Six: Head west to Osaka. Explore Dotonbori neon lights. Taste takoyaki and okonomiyaki. Visit Osaka Castle grounds. Enjoy a night cruise on the Okawa River.  
Day Seven: Return to Tokyo for final shopping. Seek souvenirs in Akihabara electric town. Relax in Shinjuku Gyoen garden. Depart Narita with memories of Japan.
